Backend Developer Python (Mid) - Fintech, Madrid (hybrid)

We are looking for a backend developer to join our payments team.

Responsibilities:
- Design and maintain REST APIs with FastAPI.
- Model data and optimize queries in PostgreSQL.
- Write automated tests and take part in code reviews.
- Deploy services in containers (Docker) on AWS.

Must-have requirements:
- 3+ years of experience with Python.
- Experience with FastAPI or Django REST Framework.
- SQL and PostgreSQL.
- Testing with pytest.
- Git.

Nice to have:
- Docker and Kubernetes.
- AWS experience.
- Asynchronous programming (asyncio).
- English B2.
